svg.title: Exhibit 04 — Serverless Web App
svg.desc: A web application with no servers: static hosting on S3 behind CloudFront, sign-in with Cognito, and an API Gateway and Lambda backend storing data in DynamoDB. Illustrated with an animated schematic. Repository: github.com/Anup-Narkhede/Serverless-Web-Application.
svg.text: Nothing to patch. One request path.
CloudFront + S3 → Cognito → API Gateway → Lambda → DynamoDB
